blocks.text_bn:
পাঠ ১৯
বর্ণ শিখি : ক খ গ ঘ ঙ

কল	ক
খই	খ
গম	গ
ঘর	ঘ
লাঙল	ঙ

কল থেকে জল পড়ে।
খই খাই মজা করে।
গম থেকে আটা পাই।
ঘর থেকে মাঠে যাই।
লাঙল নিয়ে চলছে চাষি।
চাষির মুখে মধুর হাসি।

আমি কলা খাই।
গরু খড় খায়।
মেয়েটি গয়না পরেছে।
ঘড়ি টিকটিক করে চলে।
ব্যাঙ ডাকে ঘ্যাঙ ঘ্যাঙ।

image_slots.scene_description: ক — কল থেকে জল পড়ছে; object-only (NCTB p26 এর মতো একটি কল/ট্যাপ থেকে পানির ধারা), কোনো মানুষ নেই।
image_slots.compliance_note: object-only; a water tap with a stream of water (matches NCTB p26); no living being, no stripe.
image_slots.prompt: A simple children's-textbook illustration of a metal water tap with a stream of water flowing from it, centred, on a plain white background. Bold clean outlines, soft flat colour, no people, no other objects. High contrast so it stays legible in black-and-white photocopy.

image_slots.scene_description: খ — খই; NCTB p26 তে দুই মেয়ে খই খাচ্ছে (C-01/C-02)। বদলে object-only: একটি বাটিতে খই।
image_slots.compliance_note: REPLACES NCTB two-girls-eating-khoi image (C-01 pairing + C-02 dress). New: object-only bowl of puffed rice (খই); no figures, no living being, no stripe.
image_slots.prompt: A simple children's-textbook illustration of a bowl full of puffed rice (khoi), centred, on a plain white background. Bold clean outlines, soft flat colour, no people, no other objects. High contrast so it stays legible in black-and-white photocopy.

image_slots.scene_description: গ — গম ও আটা; object-only: গমের স্তূপ ও একটি বাটিতে আটা (NCTB p26 এর মতো), কোনো মানুষ নেই।
image_slots.compliance_note: object-only; a heap of wheat grains and a bowl of flour (matches NCTB p26); no living being, no stripe.
image_slots.prompt: A simple children's-textbook illustration of a small heap of wheat grains beside a bowl of wheat flour, centred, on a plain white background. Bold clean outlines, soft flat colour, no people, no other objects. High contrast so it stays legible in black-and-white photocopy.

image_slots.scene_description: ঘ — ঘর; NCTB p26 তে একটি বাড়ি + এক ছেলে (খালি-গা/লুঙ্গি ভঙ্গি, C-02)। বদলে object-only: একটি গ্রামীণ ঘর/বাড়ি, কোনো মানুষ নেই।
image_slots.compliance_note: REPLACES NCTB house+boy image (boy short-clothed: C-02). New: object-only village house; no figure, no living being, no stripe.
image_slots.prompt: A simple children's-textbook illustration of a small tidy village house with a sloped roof and a door and windows, centred, on a plain white background. Bold clean outlines, soft flat colour, no people, no other objects. High contrast so it stays legible in black-and-white photocopy.

image_slots.scene_description: ঙ — লাঙল নিয়ে চাষি (b04 বাক্যের সাথে); NCTB p26 তে খালি-গা চাষি লাঙল কাঁধে (C-02 dress)। reframe: modestly-dressed চাষি (পূর্ণ পোশাক) কাঁধে লাঙল নিয়ে মাঠে, একক পুরুষ।
image_slots.compliance_note: NCTB p26 shows a bare-torso farmer carrying a plough (C-02 dress). REFRAMED: single adult male farmer in modest full clothing (full-sleeve shirt + full-length lungi/trousers, hem below knee), carrying a plough (লাঙল) over the shoulder, walking to the field; no bare torso, no other people. Adult male not a cast child (incidental চাষি). Stripe lands on plain field-ground clear of face/hands and the plough; high-contrast line-art for B/W.
image_slots.prompt: A warm children's-textbook illustration of a single farmer in modest full-length clothing — a full-sleeve shirt and full-length lower garment — carrying a wooden plough over his shoulder as he walks toward a green field, smiling gently. Plain light background, soft watercolour style, clean bold outlines. No bare skin beyond hands and face, no other people. High contrast so it stays legible in black-and-white photocopy.

image_slots.scene_description: ছবি-দেখি নাম ছবি: কলা — object-only (একটি কলা/কাঁদি)।
image_slots.compliance_note: object-only banana; no living being, no stripe.
image_slots.prompt: A simple children's-textbook illustration of a ripe banana, centred, on a plain white background. Bold clean outlines, soft flat colour, no other objects. High contrast for black-and-white photocopy.

image_slots.scene_description: ছবি-দেখি নাম ছবি: খড় — object-only (একগুচ্ছ খড়)।
image_slots.compliance_note: object-only straw bundle; no living being, no stripe.
image_slots.prompt: A simple children's-textbook illustration of a bundle of dry straw, centred, on a plain white background. Bold clean outlines, soft flat colour, no other objects. High contrast for black-and-white photocopy.

image_slots.scene_description: ছবি-দেখি নাম ছবি: গয়না; NCTB p27 তে গয়না-পরা এক নারী (প্রাপ্তবয়স্ক নারী চিত্র, C-02/C-05)। বদলে object-only: গয়নার সেট (হার/চুড়ি/দুল), কোনো ব্যক্তি নেই।
image_slots.compliance_note: REPLACES NCTB woman-wearing-jewellery image (adult female figure: C-02/C-05). New: object-only jewellery set (necklace, bangles, earrings) laid out; no person, no living being, no stripe.
image_slots.prompt: A simple children's-textbook illustration of a set of jewellery — a necklace, a pair of bangles and earrings — laid out together, centred, on a plain white background. Bold clean outlines, soft flat colour, no people, no other objects. High contrast for black-and-white photocopy.

image_slots.scene_description: ছবি-দেখি নাম ছবি: ঘড়ি — object-only (একটি পকেট/টেবিল ঘড়ি)।
image_slots.compliance_note: object-only clock; no living being, no stripe.
image_slots.prompt: A simple children's-textbook illustration of a round analog clock, centred, on a plain white background. Bold clean outlines, soft flat colour, no other objects. High contrast for black-and-white photocopy.

image_slots.scene_description: ছবি-দেখি নাম ছবি: ব্যাঙ — single animal spotlight।
image_slots.compliance_note: single frog (ব্যাঙ), calm posture; kept clear of lower third where stripe lands; high-contrast line-art for B/W.
image_slots.prompt: A friendly children's-textbook illustration of a single small frog sitting calmly, centred, on a plain white background. Simple bold outlines, soft flat colour, no other objects. High contrast for black-and-white photocopy.
